tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Dark is the primary theme: true black on OLED.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Widgets, list groups, sheets and cards that sit on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pressed states, switch tracks when off, segmented-control wells, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and inside widgets. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary buttons, chips, switch outline). 3:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised. Also the fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (row subtitles, widget labels) on bg, surface and surface-raised. 6.9:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and inactive tab labels on bg and surface only (4.5:1+). Not on surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, selected chip, selected segment).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single signal colour, as a fill: recording, live, the active-tab dot, switch-on track, destructive buttons. Put on-accent on it. For red text use accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and the switch thumb on an accent fill (4.6:1+).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Red text and glyphs (destructive row titles, one highlighted numeral, LIVE labels) on bg, surface and surface-raised in dark; on bg and surface in light.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and dots (charged, connected) on bg, surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word or glyph; never told apart from accent by hue alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring offset 2px from the control, on every surface (≥15:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: dot-xl
styles.usage: Lock-screen clock and one hero numeral per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles, section heads inside a screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: List-row titles, button labels at size lg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Turn off everything you don't need.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Widget labels, section overlines, tab labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Status bar, row values, units and readouts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; dot-meter gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between widgets in a grid; vertical padding of compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; widget and list-group padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top padding under a dot-m screen title.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Breathing room above a hero numeral.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Segmented-control segments, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: List groups, inputs, sheets' inner cards.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Widgets and bottom sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, switches, the tab-bar indicator.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of every control.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of a dot in the dot grid, dot meter and tab indicator.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Centre-to-centre spacing of the dot grid.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Icon stroke and control border width.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height, excluding the home-indicator inset.
